close_reason: Fix landed in commit redacting BackendChangesError::Other Display via SERVER_FAIL_INTERNAL_DESC in the From impl. Added backend_changes_error_other_drops_display_text test mirroring server_fail_from_backend_drops_display_text. Test verified to catch the bug (fails when fix reverted).
description:
crate-jmap-server/src/backend.rs:551-565 — impl From<BackendChangesError<E>> for jmap_types::JmapError uses JmapError::server_fail(inner.to_string()) for the Other(inner) arm. handlers.rs handle_changes (line 174) and handle_query_changes (line 346) both call .map_err(JmapError::from)? on BackendChangesError, which routes Other(e) through this From impl. This bypasses the server_fail_from_backend helper that the same handlers.rs module-doc and handle_get / handle_query carefully use elsewhere to STRIP backend-error Display output before it reaches the wire (bd:JMAP-wlip.2 contract).

Trigger: any *-server consumer whose backend returns BackendChangesError::Other(e) with an Error whose Display interpolates credential / blob / PII text. The text lands in serverFail.description on the JMAP wire.

The handlers module doc and JmapBackend::Error doc both establish "backends MUST NOT leak this in Display, AND we redact at the handler layer as defence-in-depth". The From impl is the third layer that should redact but does not.

Fix: change the Other(inner) arm to JmapError::server_fail(SERVER_FAIL_INTERNAL_DESC) (or delete the From impl and require handlers to use server_fail_from_backend explicitly via .map_err(|e| match e { TooManyChanges{..} => JmapError::from(e), Other(inner) => server_fail_from_backend(&inner) }) — the latter is more explicit, the former is one line).

Also need a parallel test in handlers.rs that constructs a BackendChangesError::Other with a canary-bearing error and confirms the canary does not appear in the wire response, mirroring server_fail_from_backend_drops_display_text in handlers.rs:391.
title: BackendChangesError::Other leaks backend Display via From<...> for JmapError
